function.name: get_business_summary
function.description: Merchant's total outstanding (money customers owe), how many customers owe, total collected this month, and the split of this month's collections by payment method (cash, upi, ...). Use for 'kitna baaki hai', 'total udhaar', 'is mahine kitna aaya', 'cash vs UPI'.

function.name: get_customer_balance
function.description: Balance for ONE customer. Pass customer_name as the user said it, or customer_id if the user already picked one. Returns status found / ambiguous (several matches: ask the user which one) / not_found.

customer_id.description: Exact id of a customer the user picked.

function.name: list_recent_transactions
function.description: Incomes, expenses and khata entries (credit = maal/udhaar diya, payment = paisa mila) within the last `days` days, newest first, with date, customer, amount and type. For old entries ('older than 6 months', '200 din pehle') use days=365. The returned from/to are the SEARCH WINDOW, not transaction dates.

days.description: Look back this many days including today (default 30).

older_than_days.description: Instead of days: entries dated at least this many days ago ('older than 6 months' = 180, '200 din pehle ki entries' = 200).

function.name: get_top_defaulters
function.description: Customers who owe money, biggest first, with since when (owing_since = oldest unpaid credit) and days_owing. Use for 'sabse zyada kaun deta hai', 'who owes me most', 'kiska paisa purana atka hai', and to LIST all customers who owe (set limit 50).

sort.description: amount = biggest balance first (default); oldest = longest-owed first (for 'sabse purana udhaar', 'oldest dues').

function.name: get_collections_summary
function.description: Money collected from customers in a period: today, this_week (Monday to today) or this_month. Total, count and split by payment method.

function.name: search_customer
function.description: Find every customer whose name contains the given text, with their ids and balances. Use when the user names someone and you need to see all matches.

name.description: Name or part of a name.

function.name: get_cashbook_summary
function.description: Income (sales, aamdani) and expenses (kharcha) recorded in the cashbook for today, this_week (Monday to today) or this_month, with counts and net (income - expenses). Use for 'aaj kitni income/sale hui', 'is mahine kitna kharcha'. NOT collections: money received from khata customers is get_collections_summary.

function.name: search_help_docs
function.description: Search the Bolcash help guide for how to use the app (add customer, add entry, reminders, export, staff, language, backup, deleting entries...). Returns up to 3 docs with their steps; an empty list means it is not in the help guide. Call this for EVERY question about using the app, not about the merchant's money.

query.description: The how-to question as a few ENGLISH keywords, whatever language the user asked in, e.g. 'send reminder whatsapp'.
